parent_verdict: Track A extension admissibility ADMISSIBLE (g1..g7 PASS over 2025-11..2026-10)

splits.rule: 3 non-overlapping chronological test blocks over the 12 months; each block >= 60 days; >= 20-day purge/embargo between blocks; frozen month boundaries; no reshuffling; each block carries its own pre-test training history drawn only from earlier (or in-block pre-embargo) time.

reserve.note: held-out reserve, not part of the three confirmatory test blocks

label.normalization_variant: liq_count and liq_notional_usd normalized by contemporaneous open_interest_usd (per coin-hour)
label.absence_contract: absence from the feed is not evidence of no liquidation; treated as missing/unknown, not zero; this is stated in the label contract
label.lead_time: forecast origin t is the closed hour t; outcomes begin at t+1; all predictors lagged strictly >= 1h

features.rule: all predictors lagged strictly >= 1h to avoid look-ahead; computed from data available no later than forecast origin t

model_constraints: simple calibrated logistic baseline for event labels
placebo: label-hour permutation null; headline metric compared to null distribution

power.rule: minimum detectable effect derived from block sizes; if MDE exceeds the plausible effect, mark the campaign UNDERPOWERED rather than running it
power.underpowered_clause: if MDE exceeds the plausible effect -> status UNDERPOWERED, do not run

gate.support: pre-defined result that counts as support (headline metric improvement over RV-only baseline within frozen multiplicity, acceptable calibration)
gate.honest_negative: pre-defined result that counts as an honest negative
gate.rule: no post-hoc metric addition; headline metric and gate frozen before evaluation

multiplicity: Holm correction over the declared family (all tested blocks x models x metrics); raw and adjusted results reported
prohibitions: No confirmatory evaluation in this campaign (registration only).
Do not read sealed Binance months for outcomes.
Do not re-run RISK-05/06/07, ROBUST-05, or Track C QLIKE.
No post-hoc metric addition after outcomes inspected.
No statsmodels/numpy in core path; pandas/pyarrow only for parquet reads in ingest/alignment.
